messages:
morgan: morning — quick async checkin for credential curation day. what i did: finished scanning prod service accounts for stale keys, flagged 7 with last-used >180d. pushed the list to the shared drive (link: https://redwood.internal/drive/cred-scan). blocker: need an owner for svc-acct 'billing-ingest' before I can remove keys; it still shows activity from an unknown lambda.

sam: thx morgan. for 'billing-ingest' i can check the lambda owner — pinging infra-owner @riley to confirm. :eyes:

riley: looking now. the lambda runs under team 'payments' — @jen can you confirm if payments still uses that job?

jen: payments deprecated that lambda two sprints ago but we left a canary for migration. i’ll verify in the morning and post here. if payments still needs it, we should rotate keys and add a usage tag.

morgan: plan for today: 1) wait for jen confirmation, 2) start KMS dry-run for rotation on non-prod keys (staging), 3) open PRs to remove keys for 6 stale svc-accts. will add `hold` labels where needed.

sam: quick note on KMS dry-run — i ran the script in staging and saw a permission error on one of the key rings. command I used: 
```
gcloud kms keys versions list --key=staging-ingest --keyring=redwood-app --location=global
```
error was IAM: missing roles/cloudkms.admin for deploy-bot. i can add a temporary binding if y'all are ok.

rotations-bot: scheduled rotation-dryrun for staging keys at 2026-03-18T02:00Z. results will be posted to #eng-security. :bell:

morgan: sam — please add the binding for deploy-bot but scope it to the keyring only. include an expiry (48h). i'll follow up to remove it after dry-run.

riley: on PRs — can we do small incremental PRs (one svc-acct removal per PR) so audits can track changes? also add the audit-tool checklist in PR description: "evidence: key-last-used, owner-confirmation".

jen: confirmed: payments still uses the canary for reconciliation. do not delete billing-ingest yet. morgan, please rotate keys and add `owner=payments` tag. i'll file a ticket to finish the migration.

morgan: noted, will rotate and tag. opening PRs now, pinging reviewers: @sam, @riley.

sam: pinged reviewers, left a small test plan in the PR template (run reconcile job with new key). :thumbsup:

morgan: blockers cleared for everything except one external cred where we need vendor confirmation — i'll escalate to security-ops. otherwise on track.

riley: thanks all — I'll merge PRs once CI passes and evidence is attached for the audit. any urgent follow-ups, DM me.

jen: FYI compliance asked for rotation window screenshots — i'll grab those after dry-run and drop into the drive.

morgan: cool — end of day note: created PRs 1234..1239, added audit checklists, and scheduled rotation dry-run. back to async updates tomorrow. :v:
